productionConcept: An enduring range emblem: one long heavy bodkin arrow spans diagonally across an aged leather archers bracer, with an elongated ivory edge highlight and distant small aiming glint. A calm stable emblem of reaching far, no release blast or numeric distance.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone HELLSCRIPT Ranger skill icon. Create one original square 1024 x 1024 PNG with genuine native transparent alpha. Surrounding and internal empty space must be fully transparent. Style: painterly dark gothic fantasy, worn iron, aged leather, bone and muted bronze, sculptural chiaroscuro, crisp broad highlights, dark solid midtones, restrained brush texture. Large readable forms, limited detail, strong shape distinction at 64px. Entire subject including glow and particles must fit inside central 76% of canvas, leaving at least 12% fully transparent margin on all four sides. No lettering, numbers, watermark, border, icon frame, medallion rim, UI panel, floor, cast shadow, scenery, solid backdrop, checkerboard or matte. Do not bake any background; preserve native alpha. Use restrained cohesive effects rather than clouds of tiny particles.  Internal identity (do not render text): AP01 Long Reach. Skill type: passive. Effect: Adds +15% damage when the target is 7m or further away on hit. Tags: Passive. Linked equipment IDs for identity context only: LA01, LA05, LA06, LA07, LA08, LA09, LA10, LA17, LA30, LA38. Subject and composition: An enduring range emblem: one long heavy bodkin arrow spans diagonally across an aged leather archers bracer, with an elongated ivory edge highlight and distant small aiming glint. A calm stable emblem of reaching far, no release blast or numeric distance. FINAL FRAMING REQUIREMENT: a small isolated icon floating in extensive fully transparent empty space. Fit ALL visible content inside a centered square occupying only 60% of total canvas width and height; leave 20% absolutely empty transparent margins. Output resolution must be exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels.
